intro: Ayrloom is the most widely stocked cannabis brand in New York City. It is carried at 63 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, with about 1,400 products on shelves, more than any other label. The brand comes from the family behind the Beak & Skiff apple orchard in central New York, which explains the line: cider-style drinks, gummies and a long list of 2:1 and 1:1 THC-to-CBD beverages in flavors like Honeycrisp, cranberry apple, lemonade, root beer and vanilla cola.

Edibles are the core at 618 listings, mostly drinks and gummies, followed by 403 vapes, 150 pre-rolls, 123 tinctures and 101 topicals. That tincture and topical depth is why Ayrloom tops both of those categories citywide. Prices start at $3.39, and the single-serve 10-milligram drinks run $5 to $6 at most shops, which makes them the most common entry-level item on New York menus. The deepest Ayrloom runs are at NY Canna Co in Midtown with 49 products, Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay with 47 and The Flowery Upper West Side with 43.
know: Carried at 63 of 67 licensed shops we track, with about 1,400 products, the most of any brand.
Edibles (618) lead, mostly drinks and gummies; 403 vapes, 123 tinctures and 101 topicals.
Single-serve 2:1 drinks at $5 to $6 are the most common entry-level item in the city.
Deepest runs: NY Canna Co (49), Quality Control (47), The Flowery UWS (43), Twenty8gramz and ENFLOR (41).

faq.q: What does 2:1 mean on Ayrloom drinks?
faq.a: Two parts THC to one part CBD, usually 10 milligrams THC and 5 milligrams CBD per can. The CBD softens the effect, which is why these are a common first purchase. Ayrloom also makes 1:1 versions at 5 milligrams THC.

faq.q: Is Ayrloom a New York brand?
faq.a: Yes. It is grown and made in New York by the family behind the Beak & Skiff orchard near Syracuse. Licensed New York dispensaries can only sell cannabis grown and processed in the state, so every Ayrloom product on a New York shelf is made here.

faq.q: Where can I find the most Ayrloom products?
faq.a: NY Canna Co on 5th Avenue in Midtown lists 49, Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay 47 and The Flowery Upper West Side 43. Almost every licensed shop carries at least the drinks.

intro: Camino is the gummy line from Kiva Confections, the California edibles company, produced under license in New York. It is one of the most widely stocked edible brands in the city, carried at 59 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 595 products, every one of them an edible. The line is organized by intended effect, with names like Balance, Bliss, Energy and Sleep, and each is a 10- or 20-count tin of flavored gummies or chews.

Prices start at $20.80, with most tins between $28 and $34 before tax, so Camino is a mid-priced option rather than an entry-level one. The deepest selections are at The Travel Agency Downtown Brooklyn with 20 products, and Culture House in Midtown and The Flowery Upper West Side with 19 each, followed by The Travel Agency SoHo, PRYZM and NY Canna Co. Because Camino is so widely carried, it is a useful price comparison: the same tin can vary by several dollars across shops a few blocks apart.
know: Carried at 59 of 67 licensed shops; about 595 products, all edibles.
Organized by effect: Balance (1:1 THC to CBD), Bliss, Energy, Sleep and others.
Prices start at $20.80; most tins are $28 to $34 before tax.
Deepest runs: The Travel Agency Downtown Brooklyn (20), Culture House (19), The Flowery UWS (19).

faq.q: What is the difference between Camino gummies and chews?
faq.a: Gummies are the standard fruit-flavored line, usually 5 milligrams per piece in a 20-count tin. Chews are the softer, often higher-dose format, around 10 milligrams per piece in a 10-count tin. Both are labeled by effect.

faq.q: Does Camino make a low-THC option?
faq.a: Yes. The Balance line is a 1:1 ratio of THC to CBD at 5 milligrams each per piece, and Camino also makes ratios with CBN for sleep and THCV for energy. Check the ratio on the tin.

faq.q: Why does the same Camino tin cost different amounts at different shops?
faq.a: Each licensed dispensary sets its own prices. In our data, Camino tins range from about $28 to $37 for comparable products depending on the store. Sensei shows the pre-tax menu price at every shop so you can compare.

intro: Off Hours is a New York edibles and vape brand carried at 59 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, with about 640 products on shelves. The line is built around effect-named gummies, with names like Awaken, Euphoric and Dialed, each in a 10-count pack at 10 milligrams per piece, plus a growing set of half-gram all-in-one vapes using the same naming. It is one of the few brands that competes in both categories at scale.

Edibles are the larger part at 455 listings, with 183 vapes. Prices start at $16.50, and most gummy packs sit between $22 and $30 before tax, which puts Off Hours slightly below Camino and Wyld on price. The deepest selection is at Twenty8gramz in Sheepshead Bay with 38 products, followed by ENFLOR in Jackson Heights with 31, and The Daily Green, Sweetlife and Gotham Chelsea with around 21 each. Terp Bros in Astoria is also a strong stop.
know: Carried at 59 of 67 licensed shops; about 640 products.

Prices start at $16.50; most 10-packs are $22 to $30 before tax.

faq.q: Is Off Hours a New York brand?
faq.a: Yes. Off Hours products on New York shelves are grown and made in the state, as required for every licensed dispensary. It is one of the larger home-grown edible and vape lines in the market.

faq.q: What are the Off Hours effect names?
faq.a: The gummies use names like Awaken, Euphoric and Dialed, and some use minor cannabinoids such as CBG alongside THC. The all-in-one vapes follow the same scheme with names like Dialed and Go. Each pack lists the cannabinoid ratio.

faq.q: Where is Off Hours cheapest?
faq.a: In our data the entry price is $16.50, and Twenty8gramz, Gotham Chelsea and Terp Bros list packs starting at $22. Compare the same product across shops on Sensei, since prices vary by store.

intro: Wyld is the Oregon-founded gummy brand produced under license in New York, and one of the most recognized edible names in the country. It is carried at 58 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, with about 530 products, all of them edibles. The line is simple: fruit-flavored gummies named for real fruits like blood orange, sour apple, raspberry and marionberry, in 10-count packs at 10 milligrams per piece, with ratio versions that add CBD, CBN or CBC.

Prices start at $17.60, with most packs between $26 and $30 before tax. Sweetlife on the Upper East Side, Bud & Honey in Flatiron and The Travel Agency SoHo each list 15 Wyld products, the deepest runs in the city, with Verdi Chelsea, The Travel Agency Downtown Brooklyn and The Flowery East Village close behind at 14. Because almost every shop carries it, Wyld is the easiest brand to find on short notice and a good benchmark for comparing gummy prices across the city.
know: Carried at 58 of 67 licensed shops; about 530 products, all gummies.
Flavors named for real fruit; ratio versions with CBD, CBN (sleep) or CBC.
Prices start at $17.60; most 10-packs are $26 to $30 before tax.
Deepest runs: Sweetlife, Bud & Honey and The Travel Agency SoHo (15 each).

faq.q: What is the difference between Wyld and Good Tide?
faq.a: Good Tide is Wyld's sister brand, made with solventless rosin rather than distillate. Wyld is the larger and cheaper line; Good Tide is carried at fewer shops and starts around $25. Both are 10-count gummy packs.

faq.q: Which Wyld gummies are for sleep?
faq.a: The ones labeled with CBN, often an indica-leaning flavor like elderberry. Wyld's 1:1 THC-to-CBD packs are the gentler daytime option. Check the ratio on the pack.

faq.q: Is Wyld made in New York?
faq.a: Yes. Wyld licenses its recipes to New York producers, so the gummies sold at licensed dispensaries here are made in the state, as the law requires.

intro: MFNY is a New York producer best known for live resin, and the second-most stocked brand in the city after Ayrloom. It is carried at 57 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track, with about 1,090 products on shelves across more categories than almost any other label: 376 vapes, 257 edibles, 205 concentrates, 155 pre-rolls and 88 tinctures. That concentrate count makes MFNY the deepest dab brand in New York by a wide margin.

Prices start at $4.21 for single live resin gummies, and the three-pack gummies around $5 are a common entry item. Cartridges, infused pre-rolls and concentrates run higher, with live resin tinctures in the $40 to $50 range. The deepest selections are at Cannavita in Astoria with 48 products, Weedside in Woodside with 43, Qube and The Daily Green in Midtown with 42 each, and Quality Control and Terp Bros with 34. If live resin is what you shop for, MFNY is the brand to compare across stores.
know: Carried at 57 of 67 licensed shops; about 1,090 products.
Widest category spread of any major brand: vapes, edibles, concentrates, pre-rolls and tinctures.
205 concentrates, the most of any brand in the city; prices start at $4.21.
Deepest runs: Cannavita (48), Weedside (43), Qube and The Daily Green (42).

faq.q: What is live resin?
faq.a: An extract made from flower that is frozen immediately after harvest rather than dried, which keeps more of the plant's aroma compounds. MFNY uses it across its cartridges, concentrates, gummies and tinctures, which is unusual for an edible line.

faq.q: Where can I find the most MFNY products?
faq.a: Cannavita in Astoria lists 48, Weedside in Woodside 43, and Qube and The Daily Green in Midtown 42 each. For concentrates specifically, Qube, Gotham Chelsea and Buzzy all carry MFNY cases.

faq.q: Is MFNY expensive?
faq.a: It spans the range. Single live resin gummies start at $4.21, three-packs around $5, while cartridges and concentrates run $40 and up. The average MFNY listing in our data is about $45 before tax.

intro: Ruby Farms is a New York grower that has become the most stocked pre-roll brand in the city. It is carried at 54 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 980 products, and 752 of those are pre-rolls, more than any other brand's total in that category. The signature format is the Doobie, a half-gram joint sold in seven-packs, alongside singles, infused versions and a smaller line of 95 flower listings, 79 vapes and 29 topicals.

Prices start at $12.60, with seven-packs of Doobies around $38 before tax at most shops and singles in the mid-teens. The deepest runs are at The Travel Agency Downtown Brooklyn with 44 products, Milligrams in Greenpoint and The Travel Agency SoHo with 41 each, CONBUD on the Lower East Side with 40, and Grow Together in Coney Island with 40. Dagmar's three stores and ENFLOR in Jackson Heights also stock it heavily. If you buy pre-rolls in New York, you will see Ruby Farms almost everywhere.
know: Carried at 54 of 67 licensed shops; about 980 products.

faq.q: What is a Ruby Farms Doobie?
faq.a: A half-gram pre-roll sold in packs of seven, totaling 3.5 grams, usually around $38 before tax. Ruby Farms makes them in many strains, so the same pack name appears with different genetics across shops.

faq.q: Does Ruby Farms sell flower?
faq.a: Yes, 95 flower listings across the city, but pre-rolls are the overwhelming focus at 752. Ruby Farms also makes 29 topicals, which puts it third in that category citywide.

faq.q: Which shop has the most Ruby Farms?
faq.a: The Travel Agency Downtown Brooklyn, with 44 products, followed closely by Milligrams in Greenpoint, The Travel Agency SoHo, CONBUD and Grow Together. In the West Village, Dagmar on Jane Street carries 29.

intro: Grön is an Oregon-founded edibles company known for its pearl-shaped gummies and chocolate, produced under license in New York. It is carried at 48 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 590 products, all edibles. The line includes Pearls, Mega Pearls at a higher dose, dark and milk chocolate bars and mini bars, with ratio versions that pair THC with CBN for sleep or CBG for daytime.

Prices start at $12.80, and most packs land between $14 and $22 before tax, which makes Grön one of the cheaper major edible brands and the one with the lowest average price in our data at about $22. The deepest selection is at Quality Control in Sheepshead Bay with 34 products, followed by The Flowery Upper West Side with 25, Gotham Buds in Harlem with 24, Stash Master in Bushwick with 23, Twenty8gramz with 21 and RNR in Bushwick with 20. Brooklyn shops carry it especially well.

faq.q: What are Grön Pearls?
faq.a: Small round gummies, usually 10 per pack at 10 milligrams each. Mega Pearls are the same shape at a higher dose per piece. Flavors include blackberry, blue razzleberry and others, each paired with a cannabinoid ratio.

faq.q: Does Grön make chocolate?
faq.a: Yes. Dark and milk chocolate bars and mini bars, including sleep-oriented versions with CBN. Mini bars start around $14 before tax in our data.

faq.q: How is Grön pronounced?
faq.a: Like 'grun,' from the Swedish word for green. On Sensei and most menus it appears as Grön or Gron.

intro: Eaton Botanicals is a New York edibles brand from Madison County, carried at 46 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 285 products. The line is mostly gummies, 251 listings, with a smaller run of 35 pre-rolls. Its best-known product is Apple A Day, a 20-count apple gummy sold in several ratios including a 1:4 THC-to-CBD version aimed at people who want a mild dose.

Prices start at $17, with most 20-packs between $31 and $36 before tax, a reasonable per-piece price given the count. No single shop carries a huge run: ENFLOR in Jackson Heights and Highest Standards in FiDi list 11 each, Happy Buds in Bed-Stuy and CONBUD on the Lower East Side 10, and Mighty Lucky and Alta nine. Because the brand is spread thinly across many stores, almost any licensed shop will have a few Eaton Botanicals gummies, but the full flavor range takes some looking.

faq.q: What is Apple A Day?
faq.a: Eaton Botanicals' flagship gummy: a 20-count apple-flavored pack sold in a standard 100-milligram THC version and a 1:4 THC-to-CBD version with 50 milligrams of THC total. The 1:4 pack is one of the gentler options on New York shelves.

faq.q: Is Eaton Botanicals a New York company?
faq.a: Yes. It is based in Eaton, in Madison County in central New York, and grows and makes its products in the state. The pre-rolls use its own flower.

faq.q: Why does no shop carry many Eaton Botanicals products?
faq.a: The line itself is compact, built around a few gummy flavors in a few ratios. Eleven products at one shop, as at ENFLOR or Highest Standards, is close to the full range.

intro: Fernway is a vape-only brand that started in Massachusetts and now produces in New York, carried at 46 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 570 products, every one a vaporizer. The line is organized into a Flavor Line with names like Alpine Strawberry, and strain-specific options, sold as one-gram all-in-ones, two-gram Traveler models and cartridges. It is one of the three most-stocked vape brands in the city alongside Jaunty and STIIIZY.

Fernway sits at the premium end: prices start at $25, but the common one-gram all-in-one runs about $50 and the PRO and two-gram Traveler models $83 to $95 before tax, giving it the second-highest average price of the brands we track at about $66. The deepest runs are at Qube in Midtown with 29 products, Brooklyn Bourne in Flatbush with 24, Cannavita in Astoria with 23, Torches in Midtown and ENFLOR in Jackson Heights with 22, and Twenty8gramz with 21. Twenty8gramz and Qube also list the lowest Fernway entry prices.
know: Carried at 46 of 67 licensed shops; about 570 products, all vapes.
All-in-ones in one-gram and two-gram Traveler formats, plus cartridges; Flavor Line and strain lines.
Prices start at $25; one-gram all-in-ones are about $50, Traveler PRO models $83 to $95.
Deepest runs: Qube (29), Brooklyn Bourne (24), Cannavita (23), Torches and ENFLOR (22).

faq.q: What is the Fernway Traveler?
faq.a: Fernway's larger all-in-one, available in two-gram versions and a PRO model with a bigger battery. They are the brand's most expensive products at $83 to $95 before tax, against about $50 for the standard one-gram unit.

faq.q: Is Fernway worth the price?
faq.a: It is a premium vape brand with a loyal following for its flavor consistency. Whether the premium makes sense depends on how much you vape; Jaunty and STIIIZY offer comparable formats for less at most shops.

faq.q: Where is Fernway cheapest in New York?
faq.a: In our data Twenty8gramz in Sheepshead Bay lists Fernway from $28, and Qube and Brooklyn Bourne from $32. Most shops start around $50. Compare the specific product on Sensei before buying.

intro: Dank By Definition is a New York grower focused entirely on flower and pre-rolls, carried at 45 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 520 products. It is the second-most stocked flower brand in the city at 217 listings and the second-most stocked pre-roll brand at 304, which makes it one of the few New York labels competing at the top of both categories. The flower is sold by the eighth and in larger 14- and 28-gram bags.

Prices start at $7.50 for the cheapest pre-rolls, with eighths around $45 and ounces up to about $185 before tax. The deepest runs are at Cannavita in Astoria with 41 products, PRYZM in the East Village with 37, Happy Buds in Bed-Stuy with 35, Superfly on the Upper West Side with 29, Stash Master in Bushwick with 28 and Poppin in Chelsea with 25. Cannavita, Happy Buds and Stash Master also list the lowest Dank By Definition entry prices at $7.50 to $10.

faq.q: Does Dank By Definition sell ounces?
faq.a: Yes. Alongside eighths, it lists 14-gram and 28-gram bags of some strains, with ounces around $185 before tax in our data. New York's possession limit is three ounces, so a single ounce is well within it.

faq.q: Which shop has the most Dank By Definition?
faq.a: Cannavita in Astoria with 41 products, then PRYZM in the East Village with 37 and Happy Buds in Bed-Stuy with 35. All three also start under $11 for the brand's cheapest pre-rolls.

faq.q: Is Dank By Definition indoor or outdoor flower?
faq.a: Sensei does not track grow method. The brand grows in New York and sells a range of strains across price tiers, so check the specific listing and its THC percentage on the shop's menu.

intro: Jetty Extracts is a California-founded extraction company, best known for solventless and high-THC vapes, that now produces under license in New York. It is carried at 42 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 355 products: 317 vapes, 28 concentrates and a few pre-rolls and a tincture. The vapes come as one-gram cartridges, all-in-ones and high-THC disposables in classic strains like Acapulco Gold.

Jetty is the most expensive brand we track by average price, at about $75 before tax. Entry prices start at $19.92, but a one-gram cartridge typically runs $46 to $49 and the high-THC disposables around $63. The deepest runs are at Terp Bros in Astoria with 26 products, Highest Standards in FiDi with 24, The Daily Green in Midtown with 20, Twenty8gramz with 19, The Flowery Upper West Side with 18 and Quality Control with 17. The Flowery Upper West Side lists the lowest Jetty entry price at $20.
know: Carried at 42 of 67 licensed shops; about 355 products, mostly vapes.

faq.q: What is Jetty known for?
faq.a: Solventless extraction, meaning concentrates and vape oil made with ice water and pressure rather than butane or ethanol, and high-THC cartridges. Jetty was one of the first brands to sell solventless vapes at scale in California.

faq.q: Why is Jetty more expensive?
faq.a: Solventless and high-potency extraction costs more to produce, and Jetty positions itself as a premium brand. In our data a one-gram cartridge runs $46 to $49 before tax against $25 to $35 for many New York cartridges.

faq.q: Does Jetty sell concentrates in New York?
faq.a: Yes, 28 listings, mostly at larger shops like Qube, Terp Bros and Highest Standards. The vape line is far bigger at 317.

intro: Jaunty is a New York vape brand and the most stocked vaporizer label in the city, with 626 vape listings, ahead of STIIIZY and Fernway. It is carried at 41 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 790 products overall, including 118 edibles, 32 concentrates and a few pre-rolls. The signature format is the all-in-one, often in 1.5-gram sizes, with strain names like Blue Dream and Alien OG, plus gummies that have become a common low-price item.

Prices start at $4.52 for two-pack gummies, which is why Jaunty appears in the entry-price slot at so many shops, while the 1.5-gram all-in-ones run about $55 before tax. The deepest runs are at The Flowery Upper West Side and Highest Standards with 45 products each, Gotham Buds in Harlem with 43, Qube in Midtown with 40, ENFLOR in Jackson Heights with 37 and Stash Master in Bushwick with 35. The Flowery UWS, Highest Standards, ENFLOR and Stash Master all start Jaunty at $5 or less.
know: Carried at 41 of 67 licensed shops; about 790 products.
626 vapes, the most of any brand in the city; 118 edibles and 32 concentrates.
Gummy two-packs start at $4.52; 1.5-gram all-in-ones run about $55.
Deepest runs: The Flowery UWS and Highest Standards (45), Gotham Buds (43), Qube (40), ENFLOR (37).

faq.q: What is a Jaunty all-in-one?
faq.a: A disposable vape with the battery and oil in one unit, no cartridge to swap. Jaunty sells them in 1.5-gram sizes at about $55, larger than the typical one-gram unit, in a wide range of strains.

faq.q: Is Jaunty a New York company?
faq.a: Yes. Jaunty is a New York brand, and everything on a licensed New York shelf is grown and made in the state. Its gummies, including the Dreamberry sleep formula with CBN, are among the cheapest edibles in the city.

faq.q: Which shop has the most Jaunty?
faq.a: The Flowery Upper West Side and Highest Standards in FiDi tie at 45 products each. Gotham Buds, Qube, ENFLOR and Stash Master each carry 35 or more.

intro: Florist Farms is a New York grower from Cortland, carried at 40 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 640 products. intro: Cannabals is a brand built around liquid diamonds, a high-potency extract, used in both its edibles and its vapes. It is carried at 39 of the 67 licensed dispensaries we track with about 400 products: 241 edibles, 136 vapes and 24 pre-rolls. The vapes are mostly two-gram disposables in strain names like Acapulco Gold and flavor names like Apple Burst and Baja Blast, and the edibles are gummies at a range of doses.

Prices start at $4.99 for single gummies, while the two-gram liquid diamond disposables run $73 to $80 before tax, so the brand covers both ends of the price range. The deepest runs are at NY Canna Co in Midtown with 37 products, Superfly on the Upper West Side with 33, Twenty8gramz in Sheepshead Bay with 31, Quality Control with 26, Stoops in Chelsea with 22 and Gotham Buds in Harlem with 22. Gotham Buds lists the lowest Cannabals entry price at $4.99.
know: Carried at 39 of 67 licensed shops; about 400 products.
241 edibles and 136 vapes, both built on liquid diamond extract; 24 pre-rolls.
Prices start at $4.99 for gummies; two-gram disposables run $73 to $80.
Deepest runs: NY Canna Co (37), Superfly (33), Twenty8gramz (31), Quality Control (26).

faq.q: What are liquid diamonds?
faq.a: A vape oil made by re-liquefying THCA crystals, often called diamonds, with the strain's own terpenes. The result is very high potency with strong flavor. Cannabals uses it in its disposables and in the extract for its gummies.

faq.q: Why are Cannabals vapes two grams?
faq.a: The brand's standard disposable is a two-gram unit, double the usual one-gram size, which is why the $73 to $80 price looks high next to one-gram competitors. Per gram it is closer to the market.

faq.q: Where can I find Cannabals gummies cheaply?
faq.a: Gotham Buds in Harlem lists the brand from $4.99 and Superfly and Quality Control from $17 for full packs. NY Canna Co in Midtown has the widest selection at 37 products.

intro: Good Tide is the solventless rosin gummy line from the makers of Wyld, produced under license in New York. It is the smallest of the brands we track, carried at 37 of the 67 licensed dispensaries with about 135 products, all 10-count gummy packs. The flavors are tropical, like guava, grapefruit and mango, and most packs are labeled by effect with ratios that pair THC with CBD and CBC, such as the 1:1:1 Balanced line.

Prices start at $25.66, and most packs run $28 to $40 before tax, above Wyld's $26 to $30, which reflects the rosin extraction. No shop carries a deep run: Superfly on the Upper West Side, The Daily Green in Midtown, The Flowery's East and West Village stores, Highest Standards in FiDi and Sunset Cannabis in Sunset Park each list six products, which is close to the full range. If you prefer rosin edibles over distillate, Good Tide is the most widely available option in the city.

faq.q: What is rosin and why does it cost more?
faq.a: Rosin is extracted with heat and pressure only, no solvents, and keeps more of the plant's full profile. It costs more to make than distillate, which is why Good Tide packs run a few dollars above Wyld's.

faq.q: Is Good Tide the same company as Wyld?
faq.a: Yes. Good Tide is Wyld's rosin line. Wyld gummies use distillate; Good Tide uses solventless rosin. Both are produced in New York for licensed sale here.

faq.q: What does 1:1:1 mean on a Good Tide pack?
faq.a: Equal parts THC, CBD and CBC, usually 10 milligrams of each per piece. The Balanced line uses that ratio; other packs lean toward THC with smaller amounts of the other cannabinoids.
